description: The 3W project publishes time-series benchmark data on undesirable events in offshore oil wells and a Python toolkit for comparative machine-learning experiments. Its maintained repository describes versioned data and code with separate release rules. The provider is Petrobras and 3W contributors. Coverage: Coverage concerns oil-well events from three source categories. This review did not establish a common date span, sampling rate, well inventory or complete geographic extent. Access: The repository documents data structure, toolkit use and community benchmarks. Data files were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The README explicitly assigns CC-BY-4.0 to the Parquet data files and Apache 2.0 to code. Public access is free. Limitations: Do not infer that every trace is a measured field event or that the sample represents all offshore conditions. Toolkit choices and dataset versions affect comparisons. For simulation it supports anomaly-detection benchmarks and model calibration for offshore production systems. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers the Petrobras 3W benchmark family.
